# Trimmed for the zip-agent offline sandbox (see vendor/README.md):
# - jsonschema removed: declared upstream but imported nowhere (validation is hand-rolled in reader.py).
# - cairosvg removed: needs system libcairo (unshippable offline). SVG icons must be pre-rasterized
#   to PNG (Pillow handles those) or rendered on a host with Cairo. Default flow is placeholder-only;
#   raster icons the team supplies splice via Pillow.
